responsibility: Implements the mutable iterator infrastructure for GIMPLE statement and PHI sequences. It provides the concrete logic for inserting, replacing, removing, moving, and splitting statements and statement sequences in basic blocks and on edges, updates statement operands and basic-block ownership, commits deferred edge insertions, and includes special safe-insertion handling around returns_twice calls and abnormal edges so middle-end passes can edit GIMPLE CFGs consistently.
same_name_distinction: Implements mutable GIMPLE/PHI iterator operations such as insertion, replacement, removal, movement, edge-queued insertion commits, and returns_twice-safe editing, whereas the header mostly defines iterator types and inline traversal primitives.
